|errata_history=This is version PC-E2 (3 of 3), 3 January 2023. It is the current text. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' ([[Ahsoka Tano With Lightsabers]]): PC card image of 8 July 2018<ref name="ht-ah-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/DemoDeck-Light/large/ahsokatanowithlightsabers.gif ahsokatanowithlightsabers.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018).</ref>, no errata mark. Demo Deck card: the art credit “Image courtesy of Scruffy Rebel” is printed along the bottom; the copyright line reads “Artwork not affiliated …”. Text: “Power +1 with Anakin. Permanent weapon is •Ahsoka's Lightsabers (may target a character for free, or target two characters using 1 Force; draw two destiny; target(s) hit and forfeit -2 if total destiny > total defense value).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ahsoka Tano With Lightsabers (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)<ref name="sheetP-20221212">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF, 2 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, Updated December 2022”; file created 12 December 2022). Released with [[Virtual Set P]] (24 February 2017 and 30 August 2019); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 12 December 2022: “Power +1 with Anakin. Permanent weapon is •Ahsoka's Lightsabers (may target a character for free, or target two characters using 1 Force; draw two destiny; target(s) hit and forfeit -2 if total destiny &gt; total defense value).” '''What changed:''' Changed words: the slip is the first publication of the wording of the card image [[Ahsoka Tano With Lightsabers (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), which the PC published after the sheet. The game text words are unchanged. The sheet PDF was created at 08:37 UTC on 12 December 2022, before the card image [[Ahsoka Tano With Lightsabers (Errata 2)]] was uploaded (22:10 UTC, 3 January 2023). Under the label “•Ahsoka Tano With Lightsabers” the sheet prints, pixel for pixel, the card image that the PC uploaded shortly afterwards as [[Ahsoka Tano With Lightsabers (Errata 2)]] (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 3 January 2023<ref name="ht-ah-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/ahsokatanowithlightsabers.gif ahsokatanowithlightsabers.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: re-rendered by the PC in its current card style (new frame and text font); the art credit moves to the left edge, the copyright line becomes “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED …” and the icons are redrawn. Same words. Text: “Power +1 with Anakin. Permanent weapon is •Ahsoka's Lightsabers (may target a character for free, or target two characters using 1 Force; draw two destiny; target(s) hit and forfeit -2 if total destiny > total defense value).”
